units.source_text: 我用包袱皮把佛教辞典和柏木赠送的尺八包裹好，一手拎起这个包裹连同书包，就急匆匆地赶去学校。

en.t: I wrapped the Buddhist dictionary and the shakuhachi Kashiwagi had given me in a wrapping cloth, picked up the bundle together with my schoolbag in one hand, and hurried off to school.

units.source_text: 这时候，我一心惦挂着出走的事。

en.t: At that moment, my mind was entirely fixed on running away.
